headline: Colombia Proposed Economic Rescue Law Sparks Tax and Fiscal Debates
summary: Colombia's proposed economic rescue law has drawn pushback from business councils over provisions to eliminate value-added tax exemptions on low-value international e-commerce purchases and alter social security contributions.
why: Fiscal adjustments and tax reforms alter corporate tax burdens, consumer purchasing power, and retail import volumes across Colombia.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Proposed tax changes on low-value imports and health contributions affect disposable income and retail trade.
